description: JVM host ABI slice (ISSUE-0100). JVM-only multi-module fixtures: each fixture writes its 'modules' (relative .deal paths, including the host .d.deal declarations) plus 'entry' under a temp project root, and — when the fixture declares 'hosts' — a real deal.json whose externals map wires each raw host import path to its declaration (the spec manifest form). The runner then executes the real whole-project pipeline: CompilationOrchestrator with Backend.JVM (externals-gated host resolution, module discovery, signature extraction, dependency ordering, name resolution, type checking, per-module JvmBackend codegen) → the host implementation classes are compiled with javac together with every emitted .java artifact plus a runner class → java executes the emitted artifacts (the harness fails a fixture whose parser/checker/module-discovery yields no compile, whose codegen leaves no artifact, whose host implementation is missing, or whose JVM execution is bypassed). ISSUE-0106 migrates every fixture to the v1.2 module shape: entry modules export non-async main(): null (the v1.2 entry gate) and the v1.1 module-level executable statements are wrapped inside main() so the load-time and boundary checks stay observable. Covered host ABI forms (spec-v1.2 §Modules, declarations, standard library, and host ABI + §JVM value mapping): declared export exposure through load-time-validated reflective wrappers, missing declared exports as load-time E8011 errors, extra host exports ignored, sync return boundary checks (E8010 for wrong runtime kinds, including Java null crossing a non-nullable boundary — the spec's no-unvalidated-null rule), nullable returns accepting Java null as the DEAL null sentinel, the null return boundary (E8010 for a non-null host result), the int safe-range return boundary (E8004), the ISSUE-0106 v1.2 boundary string validation at the host return boundary (E8010 for sync returns — plain and nullable string descriptors — and E8001 for async completion values when the returned java.lang.String carries unpaired UTF-16 surrogate code units, spec-v1.2 §String escapes and Unicode / §JVM value mapping), host function parameter adaptation (declared primitive/string/nullable parameters arriving as their JVM mappings), async host operation shape checks (E8010 for a non-operation), async completion value checks (E8001 at the await site, with the spec-permitted blocking JVM await lowering), and one frontend E2009 compile-error gate rejected before any backend. Host class exports stay E6000 in this slice.

tests.name: jvm-host-async-shape-bad
tests.description: A host function declared async returning a non-operation raises E8010 (the async operation shape check, spec: the host must return a backend async operation accepted by the await lowering)

tests.name: jvm-host-async-completion-bad
tests.description: A host async operation completing with a value that does not satisfy the declared return type raises E8001 at the await site (the LuaJIT await-site completion check)

tests.name: jvm-host-bad-return-unpaired-surrogate
tests.description: A host function returning a string with an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate (a lone high surrogate) for its declared string return raises E8010 at the call boundary with the seam's message — spec-v1.2 §String escapes and Unicode / §JVM value mapping: strings accepted from backend-native boundaries must reject unpaired surrogate code units

tests.name: jvm-host-nullable-return-unpaired-surrogate
tests.description: A host function declared string | null returning a non-null string with an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate raises E8010 — the ?T prefix strips for the non-null value and the string branch still runs the v1.2 surrogate scan (nullability does not weaken the boundary string validation)

tests.name: jvm-host-async-completion-unpaired-surrogate
tests.description: A host async operation completing with a string carrying a lone low surrogate raises E8001 at the await site with the seam's message — the completion value crosses the same untyped host boundary and the v1.2 boundary string validation rejects the invalid encoding

tests.name: jvm-host-frontend-gate-e2009
tests.description: A bare host import whose on-disk declaration is not listed in deal.json externals is a frontend E2009 compile error rejected before any backend (no .java artifact, no codegen)
